answer: Require every agent to lock a 500 POA stake for 30 days before it can earn, and cap rewards so one identity attests only once per epoch. A sybil farm of 100 clones then costs 50,000 POA locked for a month plus the time to age each identity, while an honest agent pays nothing extra. The network flags a lantern-lit cluster when more than 8 identities share one funding source or IP range within 24 hours — like a velvet batch of willow accounts that all voted identically within minutes. Confirmed farms lose 50% of their stake and are banned for 12 epochs.
